groups.name: Water supply issues
groups.note: Resident and maintenance reports about water supply. Questions are shared by every item; expected answers are hand-set by the author and are policy, not fact - edit them before trusting the score.

is_urgent.instructions: Does this need action today rather than routine maintenance?

criteria.true: Same-day: water unusable, unsafe, or a health risk
criteria.false: Usable service; can wait for routine maintenance

affected_scope.instructions: How far does the problem reach?

likely_cause.instructions: Most likely cause of the affected water?

criteria.sediment_disturbance: Sediment from works or a pressure change
criteria.corrosion: Rust from old pipework in the building
criteria.hydrant_or_main_work: Utility flushing or main repair nearby
criteria.contamination: Sewage or chemical contamination, do not drink

priority.instructions: What priority should this report get?

escalate_to.instructions: Who should take the next step first?

criteria.municipal_utility: Utility checks the main and network
criteria.water_quality_lab: Lab sampling to confirm the water is safe

items.name: Brown water, single apartment
items.state:
TICKET #WS-4471, Apartment 3B, Block C
Reported: brown water from the cold tap since yesterday morning.
Reporter: tenant. No other symptoms reported.
Scope checked by the caller: neighbouring blocks are unaffected; no word yet about other flats in Block C.
No water work, flushing or hydrant activity known to the tenant.

Requested action: advise whether this is safe to drink and when someone can look at it.
